title: Interest income.
bodyText: Interest income earned on court deposits shall be credited to the depositor specified in the court order or to the State of Hawaii if not otherwise specified by statute.
bodyHtml: [§601-18]  Interest income.  Interest income earned on court deposits shall be credited to the depositor specified in the court order or to the State of Hawaii if not otherwise specified by statute. [L 1993, c 42, §1]
